paras: Cyrtodactylus bhupathyi is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to India.
The specific name, bhupathyi, is in honor of Indian herpetologist Subramaniam Bhupathy.
C. bhupathyi is found in West Bengal, East India.
Small for its genus, C. bhupathyi may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 6 cm (2.4 in).
